top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms) is a distinct mechanism from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion work, is experimentally verified at the 1e-18 level in several independent laboratories, and the original proposal and realization trace to Katori and Ye. The allocation and a narrowly scoped citation are unusually well settled, so an award is preferable to no award.
